_comment: The notices shipped with Likhon, in this order: the About page's Open-source credits (settings-ui/build.mjs) and the website's /legal/third-party-licenses.txt (Web/Laravel/scripts/assets.mjs) both read this list through scripts/licenses/notices.mjs. A .txt file in this folder that is not listed here is an error, so nothing is shipped or dropped by accident. See LICENSING.md at the root.
